package.name: DO-201AD axial vertical P5.08 cathode up

evidence.method: agent-prepared: pin numbers/names and pad multiset diffed against the installed KiCad 10.0.6 symbol and footprint files; no datasheet read
evidence.notes: Scope: pin numbers and pad multiset only. lead_d_mm 1.3 = typical DO-201AD lead (1.2-1.3, e.g. 1N5822); KiCad drill 1.6. Polarity: symbol Device:D_Schottky pin 1 = K, pin 2 = A; footprint pad 1 (roundrect) is the cathode, text 'K' on silk, 'CathodeUp' = body stands on the anode lead.

notes: ILLUSTRATIVE: lead size is the family-typical value, not read from a part datasheet. POLARISED Schottky/flyback family, stood vertically (reflex D11-D20 1N5822). Pin 1 = cathode, pin 2 = anode; the vertical footprint hides the band, so mounting direction must follow the silk 'K'.
